preconditions.description: The length of the string S must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of queries Q must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= L1 <= R1 <= len(S) and 1 <= L2 <= R2 <= len(S) for _ in range(Q))
preconditions.description: For each query, the indices L1, R1, L2, and R2 must be valid and within the bounds of the string S.

postconditions.description: For each query, output 'Yes' if the substrings S[L1-1:R1] and S[L2-1:R2] are equal, otherwise output 'No'.
